why: Issue #736: the recorder samples the frame that restarts a stopped loop, so the preview workload reports the seconds the loop was stopped, hidden or closed as one long frame.
killedBy: createFrameRecorder: one warm-up, one measurement window does not sample a frame that breaks the run, and takes the next interval from it (issue #736)
createPreviewBench: the preview workload samples unbroken runs on a visible page (issue #736) drops a frame that runs while the page is hidden, and measures the run on either side of it
the preview benchmark workload (issue #736) measures only frames the preview renders while it is visible and animating
